title: FIRST BANCORP ANNOUNCES ACQUISITION OF FIRST CAROLINA BANCSHARES CORPORATION TO EXPAND ITS SOUTH CAROLINA PRESENCE
summary: First Bancorp (Nasdaq: FBNC), the parent company of First Bank, and First Carolina Bancshares Corporation ("First Carolina"), the parent company of Carolina Bank Trust Company ("Carolina Bank"), announced the signing of a definitive merger agreement under which First Bancorp will acquire First Carolina in a stock and cash transaction with an aggregate value of $166 million, based on First Bancorp's stock price of $64.22 as of July 13, 2026. The consideration payable to First Carolina shareholders consists of 1,967,017 shares of First Bancorp common stock and $40 million in cash. The merger agreement, unanimously approved by the board of directors of each company, is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 or early in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including First Carolina shareholder approval and regulatory approval.
